description: Request body for creating a token (JWT) for token exchange.

subject.description: Identity for the token. Use ~self for the current user (resolved to the authenticated principal at create time). May be another principal path if policy allows.

expires_in.description: Lifetime of the token in seconds. Optional; defaults to 3600 (1 hour).

scope.description: Space-separated scopes. Optional; default no scopes. See scopes documentation for allowed values and semantics.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the token (e.g. "CLI token").
